listitem.para: GCC 7.5.0 remains static and is supported across all &suselinux; 15 Service Packs until July 2034.

The application compiler in the Development Tools Module is updated yearly to the next major version. When a new major GCC version is introduced, the previous version remains supported for an overlap of 6 months.

The binutils and gdb packages are upgraded to the latest upstream releases in active Service Packs to address security CVEs. The glibc package is updated only occasionally when reasons accumulate (such as glibc 2.31 in SP3, and 2.38 in SP6).
